# CAREER JOURNAL 2.1.1

Role scans no longer drop a role because its job-board tag names the same term one year earlier, such as Summer 2026 on a Summer 2027 list. Those tags are often carried over; the title or the official posting decides instead.

No database migration is needed.

---

# CAREER JOURNAL 2.1.1 中文说明

岗位扫描不再因为职位板把岗位标成早一年的同一学期（例如 Summer 2027 列表里标着 Summer 2026）就丢掉它。这类标签常是沿用旧的，改由标题或官网原文决定。

不需要数据库迁移。
